$comment: Copy to agent-scaffold.config.json at the PROJECT root (next to CLAUDE.md). All hooks and scripts read this file. Paths are relative to the project root. Keys marked (auto) are filled by the bootstrap; edit freely afterwards.
$comment_profile: minimal | standard | strict. The profile sets the thresholds and gate modes that are NOT written in this file: board.lint.mode, delegation.warnAfterReads/denyAfterReads/warnAfterEdits/denyAfterEdits (0 = never deny), session.context.warnTokens, git.hygiene.worktreeDebtAsk, pushGate.maxBlobMB/bigBlobMode/requireHooksPath/mapGate/confirm, memoryBank.reuseGate, coordination.checkMode, testRunner.maxWorkers, doneGate.mode. Write one of these keys here only to override the profile for that single setting; a value in this file always wins. Fixed in every profile: destructive-git denial, subagent-recursion denial, secretScan.failClosed, secrets.mode.
$comment_humans: One tag per human who instructs agents. Used as [OWNER] in a board item's 'Human step' field; scripts/human-queue.mjs builds one queue per tag. The decision-authority lists themselves are prose in CLAUDE.md.

board.$comment_fields: Field names of the compact item template. If the board is written in another language, put the translated field names here; the board scripts read them from this map.
board.$comment_lint: Commit-time board lint. The mode (off | warn | block) comes from the profile (standard = warn); the environment variable named here overrides it for one commit.
board.$comment_signals: Used by scripts/board-staleness.mjs. For a non-English language ADD that language's words here, or the sentinel never fires.

$comment_coordination: checkMode (block | warn) is set by the profile; COORDINATION_CHECK=warn|skip overrides it for one commit.

memoryBank.$comment_reuseGate: reuseGate (block | off) is set by the profile: off keeps the map injection but never denies a write.

delegation.$comment_edits: Read/edit thresholds come from the profile: reads warn at warnAfterReads and are denied past denyAfterReads; edits warn at warnAfterEdits and are denied past denyAfterEdits. 0 = never deny. Set a number here only to override the profile.

session.$comment_lines: Status lines of the SessionStart note. Contract: the command prints ONE line or nothing; its exit code is ignored. Add your own sentinel here instead of editing the hook. This array replaces the default list as a whole.

git.$comment_shield: forbiddenCommands: [{ "pattern": "<regex>", "reason": "<why>" }] — extra shell commands the shield denies (a flag that gives false greens, a call that spends real money).
git.$comment_hygiene: autoClean false: the session start only reports merged branches and finished worktrees. true: it also removes what is provably lossless and writes a recovery log. equivalentMerge (off | squash | all): also recognise branches merged by squash or cherry-pick. worktreeDebtAsk (how many finished worktrees before the session start asks) comes from the profile.

$comment_preCommit: Extra commit-time checks: [{ "id": "migrations", "command": "node scripts/x.mjs {files}", "whenStaged": ["db/migrations/**"] }]. Board lint and the coordination archive check are built in.
$comment_pushGate: maxBlobMB, bigBlobMode (warn | block), requireHooksPath, mapGate (block | off) and confirm (ask | off) come from the profile.
$comment_secrets: Secret-file shield. mode: block | warn | off. A glob without '/' matches the base name; 'allow' is subtracted from 'protectedPaths'. These lists replace the defaults as a whole.
$comment_doneGate: command runs before a task may be closed; empty = the gate is off. The mode (block | warn | off) comes from the profile.
